claim_boundary: Fixed two-document calibration comparison of visible single-line headings and labels only. It is not a holdout, E-0022 reuse, full-page OCR score, table/value/ period/schema/Excel accuracy, automatic truth promotion, or authority to infer ReportNormId order numerically.

evaluation_policy.adoption_gate: Challenger aggregate CER must be strictly lower than PP-OCRv6, title exact-line count must not regress, empty or truncated-line count must not increase, and no numeric/period/unit/sign authority is granted. Otherwise retain it only as an abstaining proposal reader or reject it.
